{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Gatling_Gauntlet.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Durge firing flechettes from his [[Gatling gauntlet]]]]
'''Flechettes''' were small, sharp-edged metal blades, fired at high speed as projectile weapons. Normally, they were fired rapidly at one time, meaning that one salvo of flechette fire could mean hundreds upon hundreds of blades flying at supersonic speeds.

==Description==
Flechettes were small, razor-sharp projectiles that were capable of tearing through [[Blast vest/Legends|blast vests]], [[Ceramic/Legends|ceramic]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]], and [[Plasteel/Legends|plasteel]] armor when propelled at high velocities, such as being launched from a [[Flechette launcher/Legends|flechette launcher]]. Individual flechettes were housed in canisters that were launched towards a target; the canisters would then explode closer to the target, spreading hundreds of flechettes over a ten-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] diameter.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Larger flechettes, measuring up to eleven [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] were also produced, and these were intended for use against enemy combat vehicles. The [[Shaped charge/Legends|shaped charge]] [[Explosive charge/Legends|explosive]] was designed to keep the larger flechettes together, spread them over only a five meter area in diameter, allowing the flechettes to be focused against a specific area of the vehicle. Antivehicle flechettes were capable of penetrating [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] armor up to ten centimeters thick.<ref name="EGWT" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they were discovered to be a useful weapon against [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]]: while individual flechettes would not cause serious injuries, they could not be easily deflected by [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], and moreover, while the exposed skin of most organic [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] was vulnerable to them, the armored chassis of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] were not, making them excellent weapons for droid troops in close-quarters combat.

Accordingly, [[Flechette launcher/Legends|flechette launchers]] were sometimes issued to [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces used to fight Jedi, including some of the [[A-series assassin droid]]s which [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] carried aboard her personal starfighter.
